species.name: Lion
species.fact: A lion's roar can be heard up to 8km away.

species.name: Leopard
species.fact: Leopards are incredibly strong and can drag prey twice their body weight up a tree.

species.name: Elephant
species.fact: Elephants communicate using low-frequency rumbles that travel through the ground.

species.name: Rhino
species.fact: A rhino's horn is made of keratin, the same substance as human fingernails.

species.name: Cape Buffalo
species.fact: Buffalo herds can number in the thousands and are known for their strong group defense.

species.name: Cheetah
species.fact: The fastest land animal, capable of reaching speeds up to 120 km/h.

species.name: Wild Dog
species.fact: African wild dogs have an 80% success rate in hunts, making them Africa's most lethal predator.

species.name: Spotted Hyena
species.fact: Hyenas are actually more closely related to cats than dogs.

species.name: Giraffe
species.fact: A giraffe's tongue is blue-black to protect it from sunburn while feeding.

species.name: Zebra
species.fact: Every zebra's stripe pattern is unique, like a human fingerprint.

species.name: Hippo
species.fact: Hippos secrete a reddish, oily fluid that acts as a natural sunscreen and antibiotic.

species.name: Wildebeest
species.fact: Wildebeest are known as the 'clowns of the savanna' due to their erratic prancing.

species.name: Ostrich
species.fact: The ostrich has the largest eye of any land animal, bigger than its brain.

species.name: Fish Eagle
species.fact: The iconic call of the African Fish Eagle is known as 'the voice of Africa'.

species.name: Lilac-breasted Roller
species.fact: The national bird of both Kenya and Botswana, known for its stunning colors.

species.name: Yellow-billed Hornbill
species.fact: Often nicknamed the 'flying banana' due to its large, curved yellow beak.

species.name: Meerkat
species.fact: Meerkats have dark patches around their eyes that act like built-in sunglasses.

species.name: Honey Badger
species.fact: Honey badgers are famously fearless and have been known to fight off lions.

species.name: Warthog
species.fact: Warthogs kneel on their front knees to feed on short grass and roots.

species.name: Pangolin
species.fact: Pangolins are the only mammals wholly-covered in scales, which are made of keratin.
